title: Luoyang
subtitle: Eastern capital, transport node and religious-cultural city
shortSummary: Luoyang connects imperial politics, transport networks, Buddhist transmission and classical culture as a counterpoint to Chang'an.
curatorialDescription: In a Sui–Tang narrative, Luoyang is not merely a secondary city to Chang'an. Its roles as eastern capital, transport node and cultural centre show that the three-tradition network did not revolve around one centre alone.
researchNote: This is an Alpha city-level place. Longmen, monasteries, Daoist institutions and route waypoints will be added in the next content batch.
